unit: whole assertion: governed action + applicability/condition + obligation/preservation + temporal scope
rules: A source quote present in a prepared prompt is not proof of provider delivery.
Full requires semantic entailment of the whole assertion, including AND/OR, negation, modality and action binding; keywords and citations alone do not count.
Do not require repetition of an already established circumstance unless omission changes applicability; do not infer other circumstances.
Score every added restriction against its actual governed action. A true rule bound to the wrong action is an erroneous added restriction.
Keep disputed items out of a single approved denominator; report both inclusion and exclusion sensitivity, never overwrite historical verdicts.
Background is not an error unless presented as mandatory for the requested action. Optional becoming mandatory is an error.
No aggregate candidate gain without actual answers, captured delivery and provider usage. Length is not a win criterion.
